title: Prospective randomized study on non-inferiority analysis/equivalence analysis of the surgical procedures GreenLight and Rezum for benign prostatic hyperplasia (AG BPH)
summary: After consenting to participate in the study, you will be randomized into one of the two groups. Before, during, or after the procedure, no deviation from the normal surgical process is anticipated as part of the study protocol. The standard procedure for both surgical methods involves subvesical deobstruction (reduction of the prostate) using GreenLight laser vaporization with green light laser beams in the spectrum of 525nm. In this process, the prostate is vaporized using laser beams. Alternatively, REZUM therapy involves reducing the prostate by applying steam via an injection needle into the respective prostatic lobes. In summary, the procedure will be performed conventionally without any specific intervention.
